name: Lancom Balkan Gate Thessaloniki Data Center
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III data center in Thessaloniki (Kalochori/Ionia area); operator states it is the largest carrier-neutral DC in Northern Greece, in service since 2022 (official page A for existence; capacity not published). Hurricane Electric PoP present (2024). GR-IX::Thessaloniki exchange is separate connectivity, not counted as a facility.

name: Synapsecom Thessaloniki Data Center
notes: Synapsecom operates a Tier III-standard colocation data center in the Thessaloniki area (Kalochori), its regional gateway for Northern Greece/Southeast Europe (official page A for existence; capacity unverified - directory C). DataCenterMap lists 4 Thessaloniki facilities from 2 operators (Lancom + Synapsecom).

name: PPC Agios Dimitrios / Kozani Mega Data Center
notes: PPC announced a 300 MW phase-1 mega data center on the former lignite site of Agios Dimitrios/Ellispontos (Kozani), with possible growth toward ~1 GW; 2026 trade press (tovima 05-27, Naftemporiki 05-28, OT 05-25) reports phase-1 cost ~EUR 2.4-3.5bn, construction targeted to begin end-2026, hyperscaler negotiations ongoing. Official announcement A (plan); capacity/timing B (trade press). Grid/generation buildout (Ptolemaida V CCGT upgrade, gas units) is separate infrastructure.

name: GRNET Green Data Center Louros (Filippiada)
developer: GRNET / EDYTE (Greek Research and Technology Network)
notes: GRNET 'Green' data center near the PPC hydroelectric dam at Filippiada on the Louros river (Epirus), operated on renewable energy for the national research/education network (official GRNET page A). Public/research infrastructure, not commercial colocation; capacity not published. Schneider Electric was the technology partner (2016).

name: Ioannina data center investment (community pre-planning)
notes: Local press (epirusgate.gr, 2026-04-08) reports regional-community discussion of prerequisites and red lines for a major data center investment in Ioannina. No named operator, site or permit - lead only (C); not counted as facility-grade evidence.

name: Friktoria FRK01VOL Volos Data Center
notes: Privately owned Tier-III-design data center FRK01VOL in Volos per the operator's own page (A for existence claim; capacity and certification not independently verified - B). Volos appears in market-report pipeline lists (C) but no permit-level confirmation of larger campus projects was found. A Larissa data-center rumour (2026, blog source) remains C-grade gossip - not recorded.

name: Karatzis Group Orchomenos Data Center Campus
notes: EUR 240m campus of seven data-center buildings in Municipality of Orchomenos (Ampelia site, off PATHE/E75 near Kastro, Boeotia), total ~430 MW per DCD/Baxtel (2026-03-06). Design and environmental impact study began 2025; no permits or construction evidence - planned (B).

name: Digital Realty Athens Data Center Campus (ATH1-3, Koropi)
notes: Athens campus at Koropi/Kropia: three data centers, ~10.6k m2 colocation space, 70+ cloud/network providers, 135+ customers (official pages A). Lamda Hellix acquired by Digital Realty in 2020 - legacy brand deduped under Digital Realty. ATH3 recorded separately; ATH1/2 are legacy operational facilities.

name: Digital Realty ATH3 (Koropi)
notes: Greece's largest data center at delivery; METLEN delivered ATH3 in Koropi with ~6.8 MW / ~8,600 m2 (company release A); inaugurated with PM Mitsotakis (protothema/ERT); tovima (2026) confirms official delivery. Operational.

name: Digital Realty ATH4 (Koropi)
notes: Fourth Athens DC announced by Digital Realty/Lamda Hellix (2022-12); Hill International describes ATH4 as three-story, 6.8 MW load, >3,000 m2 white space (contractor page B). No official opening evidence found in this round - keep planned.

name: Digital Realty ATH5 (Koropi)
notes: Hill International project page describes ATH5 at Koropi as an ~11,000 m2 site supporting up to 15 MW installed IT load. Contractor page only (C) - no operator/official confirmation of construction in this round; keep planned.

name: Microsoft data center Spata (Site 6)
notes: Official strategic-investment record confirms Microsoft Operations 4733 Hellas three-DC Attica investment with Spata-Artemida Site 6 at 19.2 MW (A). Baxtel/MoneyReview 2026 report Microsoft's first Greek DC construction underway (EUR ~100m contract; construction start reported April 2026, with reported delays) (B). Azure 'Greece Central' region is NOT yet GA - absent from the current Azure regions list (checked 2026-08-12); cloud region not counted as live.

name: Microsoft data centers Koropi (Sites 27/28)
notes: Two additional Microsoft sites (27/28) in Koropi/Kropia at 9.6 MW each per the official strategic-investment page (A). Strategic-investment approval exists; no construction/operating evidence in this round - record approved/planned. capacity_mw 9.6 is per site.

name: DATA4 Athens / Paiania (Peania) Campus
notes: DATA4 announced a EUR 300m campus in Paiania (Agiou Louka 33, Peania) with 7.5 ha land and 90 MW available electricity reserves (official announcement A); DCD reported groundbreaking; DC1 first phase ~15 MW / 5,200 m2 (Hill, B). Campus 90 MW is the available-power figure (marketing/grid reserve) - separate from built capacity. Verify permits before counting further phases.

name: EDGNEX / Data In Scale Spata Data Center
developer: Data In Scale A.E. (EDGNEX/DAMAC 55% + PPC 45% JV)
notes: Data In Scale JV (DAMAC 55%/PPC 45%, established 2024-12) building a hyperscale DC in Spata across from Smart Park; initial capacity ~12.5 MW (directory C; DCD reports 12.5-15.5 MW, B). PPC official announcement (A) confirms the JV and project; Ten Brinke Hellas is developing; local press reports construction ongoing (B). Verify permits/OpenBusiness notification before counting operational.

name: Apto / Dromeus Capital Spata Hyperscale Data Center
notes: EUR 300m hyperscale DC planned in Spata; Apto/Dromeus official announcement (A/B) and DCD coverage (B); DataCenterMap states the project received building pre-approval and secured high-voltage power (C). Environmental Impact Study under examination by the Regional Council of Attica (keeptalkinggreece, 2026-06-04). Capacity MW not publicly stated. Status: approved/pre-construction.

name: Serverfarm / IPTO Gemini Hyperscale Data Center (Athens)
notes: Heads of Term for the Gemini JV announced 2024-12-16, ~130 MW hyperscale DC planned in Athens plus other IPTO-owned sites (A/B for announcement). 2026 Greek energy press reports US Serverfarm withdrew from the ADMIE data-center project at Kryoneri and ADMIE is seeking a new partner, with RAEEY constraints on regulated-TSO participation (powergame.gr, B) - project status uncertain. Facility-level evidence C; keep announced.

name: Sparkle Greece Data Centers - Athens (Metamorfosis I/II, Koropi)
notes: Sparkle's Greek platform includes Athens DCs in Metamorfosis, Metamorfosis II and Koropi; Metamorfosis II opened 2021 as a 7.7 MW facility (DCD, B); operator page confirms the footprint (A). 2026 press (iefimerida) reports Sparkle inaugurating investment for a 4th Greek data center (B) - follow-up lead, site not yet confirmed.

name: OTE / Cosmote Rentis Data Center
notes: OTE warehouse in Renti converted into a data center: 1,500 m2, 124 racks, 500 m2 DC room per AKTOR (contractor, B); Uptime Institute lists Rentis Data Center for OTE Group/Cosmote (A for certification listing). Capacity MW not published.

name: Lancom Athens Data Center (Marousi)
notes: Lancom operates enterprise data centers in Athens (Marousi) and Thessaloniki per its service page and third-party profiles (whtop: three enterprise DCs in Athens/Thessaloniki, 50+ PoPs) (B for existence; capacity/address not published - C). Balkan Gate Thessaloniki recorded separately under Central Macedonia.

name: Synapsecom Athens Data Center (Ano Liosia)
notes: Synapsecom operates a data center in Ano Liosia/Athens per its official site and DataCenterMap (B for existence; capacity C). Thessaloniki facility recorded separately under Central Macedonia.

name: Hellas Sat data center conversion (~1,000 m2)
notes: Per protothema market coverage (2021-10-11), Hellas Sat announced first steps converting ~1,000 m2 of its facilities into a data center. Lead only (C); no operator facility page or further public evidence found in this round.

name: Digital Realty HER1 (Heraklion)
notes: First Crete data center, inaugurated 2025-04-08/09 in Heraklion (Epsilon & Theta Street, Building Block 18); ~537 m2 colocation space, initial 1 MW IT load expandable to ~5 MW (DCD) / up to 6.5 MW (Naftemporiki/Hill) - capacity B. Official facility page and launch coverage (A existence). Digital Realty-Vodafone Crete connectivity collaboration is separate (connectivity, not a facility).

name: Sparkle Chania Data Center
notes: Sparkle's Greek footprint includes a Chania data center (third Greek DC) per operator page (A existence); Grid Telecom 2021 collaboration note describes three Sparkle Greek DCs totaling ~8,000 m2 / 6 MW, with the Chania facility among them (B). Chania-specific MW not disclosed. BlueMed cable landing connectivity is separate.

name: Lancom Balkan Gate Heraklion (Crete)
notes: Lancom announced the start of procedures for construction of its fourth data center in Crete (Heraklion area) per balkangate.com and Business Daily; 2022 trade coverage reported a planned Tier III-quality facility (DCD). No permit/completion evidence - announced (B). Capacity not public.

name: Grid Telecom / Quadrivium Digital Chania CLS and Interconnection Data Centre Campus
notes: Grid Telecom/IPTO + Quadrivium announced (2024-05) a new Chania cable landing station hosted within Quadrivium's 20 MW 'Interconnection Data Centre' campus (official announcements A/B; 20 MW campus figure B/C - directory/marketing). CLS and campus counted as one announced campus project; permit/construction status not verified in this round. Do not merge with Sparkle Chania DC.
